info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Surveys Marketing Retrieval API enables users to access marketing data related to customer surveys by specifying a unique parameter. This API is designed for businesses looking to analyze customer feedback and improve their marketing strategies. Typical consumers include marketing analysts and product managers who utilize this information to enhance customer engagement. By retrieving insights from the surveys, organizations can make informed decisions to optimize their marketing efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve a customer survey by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific customer survey using its unique identifier (CUST-100045). You can use this information to analyze customer feedback and improve your marketing strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding customer survey CUST-100045. It allows the client to specify parameters to customize the response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the customer survey data is returned.
